name: Gisa and Nahiri's Monument
aliases: odd structure being built off the coast
description: A stone monument off the Nephalian coast built by Gisa's ghouls at Nahiri's request.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises an army of ghoul builders for Nahiri to construct a stone monument.
timeline.quote: My new friend asked for an army of builders, and I have raised her one!
